criteria.statement: A production-shaped overlay enables OpenClaw and Metiq together, pins exact runtime/controller identities, uses a canonical relay-set capture, and has a captured-prior-digest rollback rehearsal.

Dedicated Metiq Signet enrollment uses containerized signetctl, reads the provisioner credential at execution time without host argv/log output, binds deny-by-default policy to one exact client, uses file-backed NIP-46 state, cleans successful one-time handoff, and supports inspect/reconcile/revoke/compensate.

The disposable-soul validator proves Metiq selection, signed addressed control/result lineage, exactly-once effects, one lifecycle method, fail-closed unsupported/conflict behavior, secret-free public projection, restart republish/state recovery, and backfill or late-result reconciliation.
Validation includes unchanged Marjam/SNR/OpenClaw evidence and restores the exact captured prior configuration digest without deleting identity or event history.
Evidence instructions are immutable and sanitized: public event IDs, public identities, digests, one-way fingerprints, timestamps, and outcomes only; no secrets or event content.
